description: NaAuS crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ccce space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Au and four equivalent S atoms. Both Na-Au bond lengths are 3.30 Å. There are two shorter (2.84 Å) and two longer (2.92 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Au and four S atoms. There are two shorter (3.15 Å) and two longer (3.46 Å) Na-Au bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.89 Å) and two longer (2.96 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to three Au and four S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaAu₃S₄ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-Au bond distances ranging from 3.14-3.25 Å. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.01 Å. There are three inequivalent Au sites. In the first Au site, Au is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two S atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Au-S bond length. In the second Au site, Au is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent S atoms. Both Au-S bond lengths are 2.34 Å. In the third Au site, Au is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to four Na and two equivalent S atoms. Both Au-S bond lengths are 2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Au atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Au atoms.
